slices.name: MVP
slices.goal: Customers can order and pay ahead, then pick up their coffee

stories.name: Drink list with prices
stories.body:
**As a** customer
**I want** to see every drink with its price
**So that** I can choose before I reach the counter

The shop already has this list on its till. See [COF-55](https://example.com/COF-55) for the design.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Drinks are grouped by **hot**, **iced** and **tea**
- [x] Each drink shows its price
- [ ] A sold out drink shows **Sold out**
- [ ] The search box clears with `Esc`

stories.name: Order summary with total
stories.body:
The last look before paying. The layout is in the [checkout designs](https://example.com/designs/checkout).

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Lists each drink with its **size** and extras
- [x] Shows the total, with tax included
- [ ] The pay button says the amount, such as `Pay £4.20`
- [ ] An empty cart sends the customer back to the menu

> Agreed with the shop: no tipping in the first release.

stories.name: Apple Pay / Google Pay
stories.body:
## How it works
1. The customer taps **Pay**
2. The wallet opens with the order total
3. The order goes to the shop

> Agreed with the shop: no cash orders in the app.

~~Split the bill~~ moved to a later release.

```
POST /orders/42/pay
```
